# Now I have both lists:
# - all_phone_friends: friends in phone contacts (with emails and phone numbers)
# - all_venmo_friends: current Venmo friends (with emails)
# Let's determine which friends to add (in phone but not on Venmo) and which to remove (on Venmo but not in phone).
# We'll use email as the unique identifier for matching.

phone_friend_emails = set(friend["email"] for friend in all_phone_friends)
venmo_friend_emails = set(friend["email"] for friend in all_venmo_friends)

to_add_emails = phone_friend_emails - venmo_friend_emails
to_remove_emails = venmo_friend_emails - phone_friend_emails

print("to_add_emails:", to_add_emails)
print("to_remove_emails:", to_remove_emails)
